optimized_sql:
SELECT i.i_item_id,
       avg(ss.ss_quantity) AS agg1,
       avg(ss.ss_list_price) AS agg2,
       avg(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS agg3,
       avg(ss.ss_sales_price) AS agg4
FROM (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 2001) AS d
JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN (SELECT cd_demo_sk FROM customer_demographics WHERE cd_gender = 'F' AND cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd_education_status = 'College') AS cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN (SELECT p_promo_sk FROM promotion WHERE p_channel_email = 'N' OR p_channel_event = 'N') AS p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
GROUP BY i.i_item_id
ORDER BY i.i_item_id
LIMIT 100
